run_static_mturk_task: run a static MTurk task with a given config, task directory, and task id
soft_block_mturk_workers: soft-block MTurk workers from blocklist file paths using a qualification name
get_mturk_worker_id: get the MTurk worker ID from a ParlAI-wrapped Mephisto agent
create_mturk_config: create an MTurkConfig dataclass with worker blocklist paths for soft-blocking workers
create_mturk_run_script_config: create an MTurkRunScriptConfig dataclass combining MTurk flags with Mephisto run script config
